# Phase Three — Final Execution Plan and Thirty Further Improvements

The first plan saw breadth, the second found bounds; the third binds intent to evidence where verification resounds.

## Thirty Further Improvements
1. Validate nonnegative finite numbers everywhere.
2. Reject zero-duration movie and scene records.
3. Clamp no creative values silently; report invalid inputs.
4. Provide protocol feature flags for future extensions.
5. Require unique scene IDs and layer IDs.
6. Require scenes to remain inside movie duration.
7. Permit intentional scene gaps for black/silence holds.
8. Permit explicit overlaps for transition composition.
9. Normalize color strings without assuming a renderer's color library.
10. Keep text content Unicode-safe.
11. Model shapes generically with subtype/data rather than one class per polygon.
12. Model charts with series/categories/value arrays.
13. Model particles with emitter semantics and deterministic seeds.
14. Model 3D depth even in 2D adapters as preserved metadata.
15. Give each adapter a stable name/version/capability manifest.
16. Add source-document provenance to adapted outputs.
17. Add conversion warnings with machine-readable codes.
18. Keep AI schema discoverable through plain JS data and JSON-safe serialization.
19. Include examples for narrative, tutorial, infographic and mixed-media scenes.
20. Include camera angle changes at meaningful story beats in the showcase.
21. Include at least three characters across the full showcase.
22. Include multiple particle systems with different emitter types.
23. Include chart, text, path/patch, primitive shape and grouped overlays.
24. Include portrait-safe UI behavior despite landscape showcase output.
25. Test adapter conversions without requiring browser globals where possible.
26. Run browser console checks after static tests.
27. Use ffprobe as authoritative duration/codec evidence after render.
28. Record artifact size and exact path in durable evidence.
29. Re-run Git status after work to identify only our own new/touched files.
30. Re-read all touched files and produce plan-vs-actual delta before declaring completion.

## Exact Implementation Order
1. Re-read clean existing integration files and locate any pre-existing movie protocol.
2. Write shared movie core as new modules.
3. Run `node --check` and core smoke tests immediately after code exists.
4. Write deterministic 180-second showcase.
5. Write Captions adapter and its smoke test.
6. Write Nesher adapter and its smoke test.
7. Write Animator adapter only as new files; wire it only if a clean extension point exists after fresh inspection.
8. Add mobile movie dock only through clean conflict-free hooks.
9. Run relevant existing app regressions.
10. Use current Animator/Nesher export tooling to realize the showcase; prefer existing proven render/export paths over a duplicate renderer.
11. Verify output with ffprobe and browser/runtime evidence.
12. Write final delta/evidence notes and close REMAINING_WORK only with proof.

## Files We Will Not Rewrite Blindly
Any currently dirty Animator core/AI/camera/mobile/export file belongs to concurrent work until proven otherwise. No reset, checkout, patch, or forced overwrite is allowed.
